scope_decisions.decision: Milestone 3 (DLT3D stereo, two-video 3D quick measurement) is explicitly deferred / out of scope for this pass.
scope_decisions.rationale: A live single-video pygame click UI has only one image plane, so only DLT2D applies. Stereo DLT3D triangulation needs two synchronized videos/cameras, which is a fundamentally different (batch, multi-file) workflow already served by rec3d_one_dlt3d.py. Documented plainly in quickmeasure.py's own module docstring and in vaila/help/quickmeasure.md.

scope_decisions.decision: GUI/CLI '>>' command-mirror parity (a convention elsewhere in vailá) is intentionally NOT implemented for this feature.
scope_decisions.rationale: Quick Measure is an inherently interactive, non-reproducible-by-replaying-one-command click session (unlike e.g. rec3d_one_dlt3d.py's batch reconstruction). The calibration-building step already has its own CLI via dlt2d.py directly, which quickmeasure.py reuses rather than wrapping.
